title: Algerian Shrimp Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Algerian-inspired dish made with succulent shrimp and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: Algerian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at Middle Eastern stores or online

instructions: Heat the aerated olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the citrusy paste and Algerian spice blend. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken stock and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until the shrimp are cooked through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
